Nepal Flood Death Toll Exceeds 1,300 as US Military Joins Relief

The death toll from floods in Nepal has surpassed 1,300 people. The US military has joined relief operations to assist in the affected areas. In a first-time disclosure of casualty figures, China reported that 31 bodies were recovered from an immigration center.
